core: Intraflagellar transport and cilium assembly control
qualifier: cilium length (centriole elongation, assembly vs disassembly)
name: Intraflagellar transport and cilium length regulation
rationale: All members are anterograde/retrograde IFT or the balance of cilium assembly, disassembly and centriole elongation that sets cilium length; unlike its superset neighbour it has no basal body docking, transition zone or centrosome duplication.

core: Ciliogenesis
qualifier: from basal body docking and transition zone to intraflagellar transport
name: Ciliogenesis from basal body docking to intraflagellar transport
rationale: Members span the ciliogenesis sequence from centrosome duplication and basal body anchoring through transition zone targeting to IFT and assembly/disassembly control, which distinguishes it from the IFT-only neighbour and from centriole-only themes.

core: Transition metal transport
qualifier: copper, manganese, cobalt plus heme and transferrin
name: Copper, manganese, cobalt and heme-transferrin transport
rationale: Members cover copper, manganese and cobalt transport/homeostasis together with heme scavenging, transferrin cycling and iron-transporter defects; it lacks the cellular iron import and systemic iron homeostasis terms of its superset neighbour and the cadmium terms of others.

core: Transition metal homeostasis
qualifier: systemic iron homeostasis and iron import
name: Systemic iron homeostasis with copper, manganese and heme transport
rationale: Members combine organismal iron homeostasis, plasma-membrane iron import and iron response with copper, manganese, heme and transferrin transport, which separates it from the neighbour lacking the iron-import arm and from cadmium or oxygen-transport themes.

core: Kinesin organelle transport and ER tubule shaping
name: Neuronal kinesin cargo transport and ER tubule shaping
rationale: Members are kinesin/RHOT-driven transport of mitochondria, dense-core and synaptic vesicles and receptors along axons and dendrites plus ER tubular network formation; unlike its superset neighbour it lacks ER localization and membrane-contact tethering.

core: Kinesin organelle transport and ER shaping
name: Kinesin organelle transport, ER shaping and contact-site tethering
rationale: Members are kinesin-driven organelle and neuronal cargo transport with ER tubular network shaping, and additionally ER localization, ER-mitochondrion and ER-plasma membrane tethering and autophagosome docking that its subset neighbour lacks.

core: LXR-regulated triglyceride homeostasis
name: LXR control of triglyceride synthesis, lipolysis and VLDL remodeling
rationale: All members concern LXR (NR1H2/NR1H3)-driven lipogenesis, adipose triglyceride lipolysis, triglyceride biosynthesis and VLDL remodeling; it lacks the gluconeogenesis, caloric restriction and adipose development terms of its superset neighbour.

core: LXR-regulated lipid homeostasis
name: LXR lipid and glucose homeostasis with caloric restriction response
rationale: Members are LXR-regulated lipogenesis, lipolysis and triglyceride control extended by LXR gluconeogenic gene regulation, response to caloric restriction and adipose development, which its subset neighbour lacks.

core: Cholesterol efflux and HDL assembly
qualifier: sterol homeostasis and reverse cholesterol transport
name: Sterol homeostasis and HDL-mediated reverse cholesterol transport
rationale: Members cover ABCA1/LXR-driven cholesterol efflux, HDL assembly and foam cell control plus sterol homeostasis, suppression of cholesterol synthesis, reverse cholesterol transport and HDL clearance that its subset neighbour lacks.

core: Macrophage cholesterol handling
qualifier: oxLDL response, cholesterol storage and ABCA1-HDL assembly
name: Macrophage oxLDL uptake, cholesterol storage and ABCA1-HDL assembly
rationale: Members concern macrophage responses to oxidized LDL and cholesterol, cholesterol import/storage and foam cell differentiation, and ABCA1/apoA-I-dependent efflux and HDL assembly; it lacks the sterol homeostasis and reverse transport terms of its superset neighbour.

core: Megakaryocyte-erythroid differentiation
name: RUNX1-regulated megakaryocyte versus erythroid fate and platelet signaling
rationale: Members are megakaryocyte development and its RUNX1 transcriptional control, restraint of erythroid differentiation, platelet signaling and erythroid-megakaryocyte modules; RUNX1 and platelet signaling terms separate it from its subset neighbour.

core: Megakaryocyte-erythroid differentiation
qualifier: megakaryocyte maturation and terminal erythroid enucleation
name: Megakaryocyte development, platelet morphogenesis and erythroid enucleation
rationale: Members are megakaryocyte development and differentiation control, platelet morphogenesis, the TAL1-GFI1B erythro-megakaryocytic programme and terminal erythroid enucleation, without the RUNX1 regulation of its superset neighbour or the general erythropoiesis of others.

core: Meiotic prophase I recombination and synapsis
qualifier: DSB formation and telomere-nuclear envelope tethering
name: Meiotic DSB recombination, synaptonemal complex and telomere tethering
rationale: Members are meiotic DSB formation and repair, crossover resolution, synaptonemal complex and telomere attachment to the nuclear envelope; it lacks the strand invasion, checkpoint and female meiosis terms of its superset neighbour.

core: Meiotic prophase I recombination and synapsis
name: Meiotic recombination with strand invasion and prophase checkpoint
rationale: Members are meiotic DSB recombination and synapsis plus DNA strand invasion, repair complex assembly and meiotic checkpoint/nuclear division restraint in both sexes, which its subset neighbour lacks.

core: MHC class II and CD1 antigen presentation
name: MHC class II, CD1 and TLR7/8-linked antigen presentation
rationale: Members are MHC class II peptide and CD1 lipid presentation modules including the MHC-TLR7-TLR8 cluster and TLR7 ligand regulation; it lacks the NKT cell terms of its superset neighbour and the MHC class I terms of others.

core: MHC class II and CD1 antigen presentation
name: MHC class II and CD1-restricted NKT cell antigen presentation
rationale: Members are MHC class II peptide and CD1 lipid antigen presentation plus regulation of NKT cell activation, differentiation and proliferation, the NKT terms distinguishing it from its subset neighbour.

core: MHC class II peptide antigen presentation
name: MHC class II peptide presentation and its negative regulation
rationale: Members are exogenous peptide loading onto MHC class II and its regulation, including negative regulation of antigen presentation; those regulatory terms are what its subset neighbour lacks, and it has no CD1, TLR or cross-presentation terms.

core: MHC class II peptide antigen presentation
qualifier: peptide-MHC assembly and germinal center B cell processing
name: MHC class II peptide assembly in germinal-center B cells
rationale: All five members are exogenous peptide processing and assembly with MHC class II, including germinal center B cell antigen processing, without the regulatory, CD1 or MHC class I terms of its neighbours.

core: Microglia and amyloid-beta pathology
qualifier: tau tangles, lysosome and synaptic effects
name: Alzheimer amyloid-tau pathology and microglial lysosomal response
rationale: Members combine amyloid-beta formation, fibrillization and clearance, neurofibrillary tangle assembly, LTP suppression and microglial activation with lysosome and glucosylceramide regulation, which separates it from the phagocytic-clearance neighbours.

core: Microglial activation and amyloid-beta clearance
name: Microglial phagocytic clearance of amyloid-beta and apoptotic cells
rationale: Members are microglial activation, migration and cytotoxicity with amyloid-beta clearance plus apoptotic cell clearance, membrane invagination and glial apoptosis, without the negative-regulation terms of its superset neighbour or the tau/synaptic terms of others.

core: Microglial amyloid-beta and apoptotic cell clearance
name: Opposing regulation of microglial amyloid-beta and apoptotic-cell clearance
rationale: Members are microglial activation and phagocytic clearance of amyloid-beta and apoptotic cells including the negative regulation of microglial activation and amyloid-beta clearance that its subset neighbour lacks.

core: Microglial activation and apoptotic cell engulfment
name: DAP12-dependent microglial recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells
rationale: Members are microglial differentiation and activation with DAP12 signaling, phosphatidylserine exposure, apoptotic cell recognition and engulfment; it lacks the astrocyte, kainate and glial proliferation terms of its superset neighbour.

core: Microglial apoptotic cell engulfment
name: Microglial efferocytosis and glial responses to excitotoxic neuronal injury
rationale: Members are DAP12-linked microglial efferocytosis plus response to kainic acid, hippocampal neuron apoptosis, astrocyte activation and glial proliferation/apoptosis, which its subset neighbour lacks.

core: Mitochondrial genome replication, transcription and translation
name: Mitochondrial DNA replication, transcription, mRNA turnover and translation
rationale: Members cover mtDNA replication and repair, mitochondrial transcription, FASTK-regulated mRNA stability and decay, mitoribosome assembly and translation; it lacks the tRNA processing and RNA import terms of its superset neighbour.

core: Mitochondrial genome replication, transcription and translation
name: Mitochondrial genome expression with tRNA processing and RNA import
rationale: Members span mtDNA replication, transcription, RNA stability and translation plus mitochondrial tRNA processing, RNA 3'-end processing, tRNA transport and RNA import into mitochondria, which its subset neighbour lacks.
